column1: # Agent wiring catalog. One row per agent the deployment points at a group.
# agent    the agent's short name, as the agent provider catalog names it.
# group    the routing group the agent selects, or - when the agent follows
# owner    repo when the deployment writes the agent's configuration by hand,
#          magpie when Magpie generates it, inherited when the agent follows
# enabled  yes when the wiring applies, no when it is parked.
# The deployment never wires Codex, and it never lets Magpie write Claude
